name: Dong Yi Ri Sheng Home Decoration Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dong Yi Ri Sheng Home Decoration Group Co.,Ltd. together with its subsidiary, provides integrated home furnishing services. It offers home decoration design; engineering construction; self-produced wood product matching; and soft furnishing design and finished home furnishing products for individual customers and residential developers, as well as act as a material agency. It also engages in the import and export of goods and technology. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
